mapping_contract.contract: After original add_assistant_message, read the newly emitted original loss_mask. First/last newly masked positions define start/end; retain original input_ids prefix and current native_response_ids. This targets original AgentGym training IDs after its own decoding/encoding and EOS handling, rather than reconstructing them from raw vLLM text.

The actor receives the original native full trajectory responses right padded by its owner, with loss_mask=zero prompt plus native response_mask. For each retained turn, destination start=turn.start−initial_prompt_length; length=min(original turn source length, retained full-trajectory response length−start). Source token identity is asserted against original retained trajectory segment. No second history row is added to actor training per DT request. Official truncation may retain only the source prefix.

Original prompts are left padded; current native responses are right padded, with explicit length attention masks. input_ids contains those exact prompt/response tensors. Source widths are independent of actor full-trajectory widths.

Deduplicate source rows by (traj_uid,env_step), retain inverse mapping, compute complete returns in sorted original environment step order, sort only request packaging lengths, original native pad/partition/reorder dispatch, inverse reorder and unpad, then scatter to source rows and duplicate inverse identities. Padding copies are not assigned new rewards or new actor rows.

mapping_contract.step: Joint DT source to current vector
mapping_contract.contract: Each current-response request retains its own vector object and source_start/end in prompt+actions+query+target. Sorting changes request packaging, not vector destination. Original dense paired runner returns signed row; slice signed[row,source_start:source_end] is assigned to vector[:current_response_length]. Prompt history/O/query/target coefficients are not copied into current source credit.

Source destination vector is FP32; runner signed source values are converted at assignment into this vector before original Q/V/A composition. Current response attention and active mask determine policy positions; official sampled complete return and signed vector enter unchanged formula. No per-turn scalar broadcast, renormalization or additional reward multiplication is inserted.

mapping_contract.step: Source QVA to final actor columns
mapping_contract.contract: Allocate full trajectory response-shaped FP32 QVA zeros. For each original (source,start,length) slice assign that source QVA prefix into actor columns start:start+length. Observation/padding intervals have no source mapping and remain zero; past turn policy tokens are filled by their own earlier-turn source rather than duplicated by later-turn DT history.

multi_turn actor uses final full-trajectory loss_mask tail, takes old_log_probs and advantages at the same response columns, and native forward returns per-response-column logprob/entropy with causal predecessor offset. Same original mask feeds PG, H and KL. Upstream PPO minibatch/epochs can reuse trajectories as configured; that differs from accidental per-turn duplicate history rows.

old_ref_update_contract.sequence: Original actor old logprob -> native ref logprob -> DT Q/V/A -> compute_advantage -> original actor update
old_ref_update_contract.ref_owner: Trainer sets ref_in_actor when lora_rank>0. Worker compute_ref_log_prob sets is_lora=True and calls same actor logprob computation inside upstream disable_adapter(), then returns ref_log_prob. Reference means the frozen base without adapters, not the same enabled policy distribution.
old_ref_update_contract.temperature: Recorded rollout.temperature=1.0; old worker sets output metadata temperature from that config. Ref uses identical native method/config. DataProto.union preserves/merges metadata; actor compute and update read that metadata temperature. Enabled fused or logits paths receive the same temperature value.
old_ref_update_contract.ppo_scope: No step within local mini32’s eight B4 backward microbatches; original optimizer steps at each mini boundary. Later minis use updated current policy while full-batch old/ref stay fixed, as native PPO specifies. checkpoint25 is the resumed starting checkpoint, not a claim that later iterations35-40/93 use unchanged checkpoint25 weights.

existing_enabled_disabled_observations.covered: checkpoint25 original step26 selected successful current-response B4/rank, original enabled actor entropy, recomputed old/ref FP32 dtypes and nonzero original ref KL, and equality among fresh enabled-forward gradient component passes.
existing_enabled_disabled_observations.missing: No stored disabled-adapter entropy vector, per-token enabled/disabled old/ref logprob arrays, or checkpoint25-vs100 same-original-ID native policy logprob/entropy comparison was found in these saved probes. Categorical native outcome logprobs in v1-v6 are reward-readout endpoints, not disabled policy-reference entropy.
existing_enabled_disabled_observations.scope_limit: v1 source_signed FP64 composition -> FP32 actor advantages is an extrema/current-response diagnostic; old readout converts signed to FP32 vector before composition. It is not a bitwise reconstruction of original historical full-batch credit.

minimal_owner_observation_for_ref_entrop.status: Available native entry only; not executed and not a new evaluation/training gate
minimal_owner_observation_for_ref_entrop.enabled: Call original worker.compute_log_prob on the existing actual PPO batch/current-response batch; returned original old_log_probs and entropys use enabled actor.
minimal_owner_observation_for_ref_entrop.disabled: Use the same original compute_log_prob path with native data.meta_info.is_lora=True. That is the method compute_ref_log_prob already calls internally; it returns both original no-LoRA logprobs and entropys. compute_ref_log_prob itself discards entropys when renaming old_log_probs to ref_log_prob. Preserve native dataset IDs/masks/configured temperature/compile/backend and ownership lifetimes; do not substitute a new forward or model.
minimal_owner_observation_for_ref_entrop.interpretation: Matched original inputs can distinguish changed policy outputs from changed state mix or reference behavior. Mean H9.83 and sampled low_var_KL .117 alone do not identify a reference defect; they are different observed quantities on finite trajectory samples.

evidence_boundary.source_exclusions: No wrong sign/index reversal, request-sort vector swap, unreversed DP partition order, padding duplication into actor columns, or temperature mismatch is implemented in the matched audited source.
evidence_boundary.not_verified: The missing complete historical source QVA/turn mapping/final actor mask and advantages arrays prevent a dynamic all-turn coverage/overlap check at the bad updates. Selected-source consistency and conservation are not credit correctness proofs.
